packageRules.description: Poetry resolves the newest release in range rather than the version Renovate targeted, so an in-range update writes a lockfile Renovate then rejects. :pinDevDependencies does not reach these groups: it matches the devDependencies, dev-dependencies, and dev depTypes, and a Poetry group's depType is its name

customManagers.description: Read `# renovate:` annotations above *_VERSION pins in dev container setup scripts
